Offline city data — GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/
Creative Commons Attribution; data supplied by GeoNames and packaged by ExifTool.
Data is approximate and supplied without a warranty of completeness or accuracy.
https://www.geonames.org/export/

The app performs no online geocoding. Source URLs, hashes and build provenance are
recorded in Dependencies/dependencies.lock.json and the bundled runtime receipt.

Distribution packaging omits Perl installation .packlist receipts and replaces
local installation prefixes in Config_heavy.pl and CORE/config.h with the
neutral /RestoreGPSTimeRuntime label. Runtime module lookup uses bundled paths.
Release native executables have developer debug symbols removed before signing.
